item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Shark Week at Clearwater Aquarium: Meet Thelma and Bruce, 2 nurse sharks
item.description: The Clearwater Aquarium is home to two nurse sharks year-round, offering education and a second chance at life for animals that could not be returned to the wild.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] FBI investigates as Michigan joins Minnesota in reporting cyberattacks on its water systems
item.description: Michigan on Saturday joined Minnesota in reporting cyberattacks on nine of the state's water systems but an official said all systems were operating "safely."

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Democrats see a chance to flip a US House seat as abuse claims mount against Ohio Rep. Max Miller
item.description: Democrats are seeing a fresh opportunity for an upset in a northeast Ohio congressional seat where the Republican incumbent is facing mounting pressure over domestic abuse allegations.
